messages:
Sam: Heads up — since ~02:10 UTC asia-south1 GPU pool is failing 1-2 attach ops/min, lots of slow-writes on local NVMe. Pods stuck in ContainerCreating.
Anya: Can you paste dmesg + iostat?
Sam: dmesg snippet:
```
[12345.678901] nvme nvme0: queue timeout (rq 0x...) write tail
[12345.679002] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 123456
[12345.679103] metadata CRC failed on nvme0n1
```
iostat -x 1 3:
```
Device:         rrqm/s wrqm/s   r/s   w/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1         0.00   5.00  1.00 450.00  4.0 3600   8.0     32.5     120.0  2.2   99.9
```
Julian: Looks like sustained small fsyncs causing write amplification — noticed logrotate running at 02:00 on many nodes.
Marta: OpsBot reported correlated Janitor + nightly logrotate overlap earlier today :alarm_clock: 
OpsBot: [ALERT] nvme_slow_write_tail spike in asia-south1 (15m avg > 80% iowait). Incident: INC-2026-453. Link: https://incidents/internal/453
Anya: Immediate mitigations: 1) bump scrub/cleaner to low priority, 2) change logrotate to stagger times, 3) taint 20 affected nodes to stop new attaches and drain GPUs off them.
Keon: Drain will take ~30-45m and will throttle capacity. How many GPUs impacted? Sam?
Sam: ~120 GPUs across 24 nodes in pool. We can route new provisioning to eu-west2 and us-west1 for next 2 hrs.
Julian: Also set `io.scheduler` to `mq-deadline` on affected hosts as a quick experiment. Low risk.
Marta: Cost note — routing to other regions increases egress and preemptible spend. Estimate extra $1.8k/hr if we move all traffic.
Anya: Short-term plan: taint+drain 12 nodes (non-critical jobs), stagger logrotate to @03:00-03:50, set cleaner concurrency to 1, monitor 30m. If persists, plan full pool reprovision next maintenance window.
Sam: Doing taint now: `kubectl taint nodes asia-south1-nvme-0 node.k8s/redwood-maint=true:NoSchedule` then `kubectl drain` on 12 nodes.
Keon: I'll open a quick canary to route to eu-west2 and watch load balancer failover. Also bump autoscaler to allow 200 extra capacity temporarily.
OpsBot: [ACTION] Created ticket OPS-789 to track node drains + logrotate change. Assigned to Anya and Sam.
Julian: Who can own the postmortem if this becomes recurring? Suggest infra-storage team.
Marta: Assigning to infra-storage. I'll write an initial incident note and cost impact baseline.
Sam: Updates in 15m. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
